LESSON: GRAFTING IN PLANTS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.1: Grafting in Plants

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Grafting in Plants
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Grafting in Plants
2. give Kenyan examples of Grafting in Plants
3. practise a safe skill for Grafting in Plants

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Grafting in Plants

Teach
• Observe Grafting in Plants in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Grafting in Plants (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Grafting in Plants.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Grafting in Plants.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Grafting in Plants.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Grafting in Plants.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Grafting in Plants: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Grafting in Plants with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
